aboutIntro: Jam3iya is a simple and smart application that helps you manage rotating savings groups with friends or family easily and transparently.
aboutFeatures: With Jam3iya you can create a new group, invite members, organize the receiving order, and track monthly payments without confusion.
aboutTracking: The app provides a clear tracking system so you can see the status of each month, who paid, who received their turn, and stay updated with helpful reminders.
aboutGoal: Our goal is to simplify traditional savings groups and turn them into an organized and secure digital experience for everyone.
aboutFeedback: If you have suggestions or ideas to improve the app, we would love to hear your feedback.

howItWorksSubtitle: Tap here to understand the full cycle from creation to completion.
step1Desc: Enter the name, amount, and duration.
step2Desc: Send the code to members to join.
step3Desc: Members send requests and the leader approves.
step4Desc: Set start/end dates and adjust duration.
step5Desc: Arrange the receiving order manually or randomly.
step6Desc: Activate the group and start distribution.
step7Desc: Members request payment and management approves.
step8Desc: The cycle ends and moves to history.
faqSubtitle: Tap here to view top questions and answers
faqQ1: How to create a new group?
faqA1:
Open the create group page
Enter the name
Set the monthly amount
Choose duration (months)
Tap Create
faqQ2: How to join a group using a code?
faqA2:
Ask the leader for the code
Enter the code
Send join request
Wait for approval
faqQ3: How to setup and start a group?
faqA3:
Open group settings
Set start and end dates
Arrange members
Tap Start Group
